''See also: [[Lyathatan Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Lyathatan is an ancient and massive [[Elderspawn]] originating from [[Kelarac]]. Described as a nightmare-like entity with features resembling sharks, it possesses six black eyes, blue-green skin, and a combination of human-like legs and fish tails. Its physical form includes clawed hands, six fingers, spines on its back, fins, and tentacles. It is capable of immense feats of strength, such as lifting ships from the [[water]] or wrestling a kraken Elder underwater. Despite its terrifying appearance and shark-like teeth, it can go long periods without food, even consuming lesser parasitic [[worms]]. The creature is currently bound to a human named [[Calder]] through a contract and shackles, which allows him to control it using his [[Intent]]. While the Lyathatan often feels intense resentment, malice, and rage toward its servitude, it obeys [[Calder]]'s commands as part of a much larger, centuries-long plan. The entity operates with an alien intelligence and complex motivations that are difficult for humans to comprehend, viewing human lives as fleeting and insignificant compared to its own vast, patient goals. It is wary of certain dangers, such as the plans of Ach'magut{{!}}Ach’magut, and seeks to eventually return to the ocean and achieve freedom.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|This massive, man-shaped [[Elderspawn]] features deep blue fish-like [[scales]] and a ridged spine. Its head is equipped with a shark's mouth of jagged teeth and six black eyes arranged in two rows of three, while its short, muscular neck possesses gills. The creature has muscular arms ending in webbed, six-fingered hands tipped with spike-like or clawed nails.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Lyathatan is a being of vast [[hunger]] and indescribable age that possesses a deep, fathomless mind. It displays passion in its expression and can be commanded or persuaded through mental links. Though it serves [[Calder]], the entity has been known to shirk its duties.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|As a bound Elder, the Lyathatan can be used to pull ships like [[The Testament]] through the ocean. It possesses an awareness that can be accessed via [[Reading]], allowing for communication and the discovery of information. Additionally, it is capable of clearing waters around a ship as part of its service.}}
